newsitem.title: UK: Willis to liquidate Sovereign Insurance.
newsitem.headline: Willis to liquidate Sovereign Insurance.

text.p: UK insurance broker Willis Corroon said on Friday it had appointed provisional liquidators to its subsidiary, Sovereign Marine Insurance Company Ltd.
Willis said in a statement the move was a "consequence of the unexpected adverse result of an arbitration with a reinsurer".

Losses at Sovereign have cost Willis 72 million stg since 1991. The group said a recent award against them in a dispute with a reinsurer had substantially increased Sovereign's liabilities, and that the board of Willis was no longer willing to support it.
